title: After #36425: a default / OBJECT.create form opened by name from a form-type action is flagged "internal" (lint + Studio rail), and stale resolveFormViewLayout comments remain
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRY38EZf38Yy3zthbY

Filed as a `finding` by seat `repo:objectstack#2` from the l2-review#4 record on PR #36543 (comment 7084658554, nits N2 and N3). Not triaged; not claimed. Waits on #36543.

## N2: a default form that an action opens by name is called "internal"

PR #36543 (#36425) adds the advisory lint rule `form-view-internal-not-loaded` and a Studio Interfaces-rail filter. Both treat an object's default form (`form`, `formViews.default`, an `isDefault` form item) and its `OBJECT.create` form as internal whenever `sharing.enabled !== true`.

A `form`-type action can still open one of those forms by its name, and apps/console `FormPage` still loads it in that case. So for that form:
- the lint message "no longer loaded" overstates what happens, and
- Studio stops listing a form that users can still reach.

The rule is advisory, so nothing is refused.

**Ask:** when an action in the stack opens the form by name, exempt it from both the rule and the rail filter, or reword the message. Pin the exemption with a test.

## N3: stale comments name a deleted function

These comments still name `resolveFormViewLayout`, which #36543 deletes:
- `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx:60`
- `FormPage.visibleWhen.test.tsx:12`
- plugin-form tests `sectionVisibleWhen-6111`, `sectionStyleKeysRetired-13626` and `modalFormSectionGroupReference-11542`

`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json` and `studio-authoring.json` also describe the retired default-form overlay recipe, and need a checklist re-audit.

## Likely lane

- N2: `domain:spec` for the lint rule (`packages/lint`), plus a ui half for the rail.
- N3: `domain:ui`, plus devx for the checklist.

## Re-check

`git grep -n resolveFormViewLayout -- ui docs/qa`: any hit after #36543 merges means N3 still applies.
